Subject: Authorization requested: runtime/platform staff expansion — 2 senior infra engineers

Team —

Requesting authorization to open and fill two senior infra engineer roles on the Runtime team (Platform/Serving runtime). This is a prioritized need tied to Q3 capacity and low-latency projects: KV cache improvements + compilation/kernel tuning work. Quick summary below: 

- Roles: 2 x Senior Infrastructure Engineer (runtime-focused)
- Justification: reduce token latency tail, enable sustained throughput for top 3 customers, ownership for kernel selection & quantization pipeline
- Proposed bands: Level 5 (senior) — comp band midpoint: $210k base; total comp target $260–300k depending on location/relocation
- Hiring plan: 1 hire to start immediate (SRE/infra replacement for Q3 launch), 2nd to follow after ramp of first (60–90 days) unless we get an exceptional finalist now
- Estimated run-rate impact: ~$140k–$180k incremental annual OTE per hire once fully loaded with benefits & equipment

Attached: comp-band-proposal-Q3.pdf (breakdown by region), req-brief-senior-infra-engineer.docx, and a candidate profile we want to expedite (Priya Shah).

Asks: executive authorization to convert the headcount (2 FTE) from hiring reserve and permission to extend offer to Priya (external candidate) if internal approvals clear. Please reply with any objections or sign-off.

If helpful, I can paste the mutual action plan and offer framework inline.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Runtime Platform
Redwood Inference

Vanessa —

Thanks for the packet. A couple quick clarifying items before I can greenlight: 

1) Are these in-headcount additions (new FTEs) or replacements that we shift from another team? I ask because finance needs to know if we reallocate or increase the overall team budget.
2) The comp band numbers look reasonable but please confirm the fully-loaded per-headcost you used (benefits, equity run-rate, hiring/relocation). The note you sent lists midpoint but not the 1.25x burden we normally model.
3) For the immediate candidate (Priya) — is she in the target total comp range or do we anticipate a market premium? If premium, what's the justification relative to time-to-fill risk?

If you can drop a version with the per-head fully-loaded number I can loop in finance and expedite. Otherwise I support the ask in principle.

- Marcus
VP, Infrastructure
